verdict.rationale: Per-result relevance scores are a fair thing to ask of a search API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a score field on search results or any way to threshold on one. The closest item, a search parameter controlling the latency-vs-relevance tradeoff and how results[].content is generated, is an adjacent control and does not earn credit. Exact-match, domain, safe-search and language filters likewise do not expose per-result scores.
